main_text.head: THEODORETI TRACTATUS XXIII.
main_text.p: Cujus mentio supra facta est, pag. 51. Is extat inter Athanasii opera T. 2. p. 325.
Πρὸς τὺς κελευσθέντας ἁπλῶς ἀπαιτεῖν ... [Greek column; continues below]
Adversus eos, qui volunt, simpliciter, iis quæ dicta sunt, credendum, nec considerandum quid conveniat, & quid non conveniat.
Πολλῶν γὰρ δεινῶν ὑπαρχόντων δογμάτων, ἐπειδὴ οὗτος πρὸς βίον τὸν ἀνθρώπων, εἰς ἐπαινεῖν ... [Greek paragraph, continues in column]

ETsi multa & horrenda dogmata sint, quæ in hominum genus ille omnis honesti sofor diabolus invenit, ut periculosis erroribus assentientes involveret: tamen haud scio an superioribus temporibus hujusmodi quid parturiverit quale nunc parturit. Nam quæ majorum memoriâ viguerunt hæreses Rum

page.notes: The Greek lines are partly illegible at this scan size; the Greek passages are only summarised where I could not read them letter by letter. The catchword "Rum" at the foot is taken as the start of the next word "Rum[?]"; the page ends with the Latin column.
